svg.title: Bodman Outfits
svg.desc:
The browser-tab mark. A circle rather than the wordmark in public/brand/logo-light.svg: that logo is 66x34 and reads as "Bodman Outfits" at full size, but scaled into a 16px tab it becomes an illegible smudge. A tab icon has one job at one size, so this is drawn for 16px and merely happens to also work at 512.
Colours are the site's own brand tokens (everglade #1b3e2d, copper #c8763a) so the tab matches the page it opens. Note for anyone editing: keep documentation in desc rather than an XML comment. A comment mentioning a CSS custom property by name contains a double hyphen, which is illegal inside an XML comment and silently renders the whole icon unparseable - it still serves 200 with the right content type, and shows nothing at all.
The letter is a serif B because at 16px a letter survives where a needle and thread does not. Georgia and Times are the safest widely present serifs; Fraunces is the brand face, but a webfont cannot be relied on inside an icon, which renders outside the page's font context.
